caption: The drawing depicts a single small bowl placed on a wooden surface. The bowl is round with a wide opening and is colored in shades of brown with darker marbled patches and subtle highlights, suggesting a ceramic material. The rim is slightly thicker and darker, and the interior and exterior surfaces display irregular coloration and textural variation. The bowl sits on a broad, flat base with a slightly elevated foot. The wooden surface beneath the bowl is light brown with visible grain lines and a carved decorative border along the front edge. At the top of the drawing, the words "SMALL BOWL" are printed in uppercase serif letters. The background is a plain pale beige or off-white color, and the drawing is rendered with careful attention to detail and shading.
title: Small Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
